Description.Name: Ferro-Aluminum Acquired
Description.Details:
<color=#BFBFBF>Yang's voice comes over the comm from the cargo bay, breathless.</color> "Commander, get down here."

<color=#BFBFBF>By the time you arrive, the salvaged transport's cargo container is already cracked open, its contents spilled across the deck plating. Yang crouches beside a stack of dense metal ingots, running a scanner over one.</color>

"Whatever this thing was hauling cargo for, they packed it right. This is naval-grade Ferro-Aluminum, same stuff Farah's been hunting for the hangar job." <color=#BFBFBF>He hefts one of the ingots, testing its weight.</color> "Can't tell you what it was meant to be used for, they stripped the ID plates clean off the container before it ever left port. Doesn't matter much either way. What matters is we've got it now."

<color=#BFBFBF>He does a rough count of the stacked ingots.</color> "Looks close to a full ton, near as I can eyeball it. Worth having it weighed properly before anybody starts celebrating."

Description.Name: Weigh the metal
Description.Details: You give the order, and a work crew hauls the ingots off to be weighed and catalogued. Yang grins, tapping the crate. "That's the last piece. Cable, sensors, comms, and now the Ferro-Alumnium. Everything we need for that hangar job is sitting in the hold." "Only thing left is finding a crew willing to actually build the thing." He claps his hands together. [The construction crew can be hired by remaining in port at a star system with the Manufacturing attribute. This may take some time to trigger.]
